armySpecialRules.name: CELESTIAL FORGED ARMOUR
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule gain a Magical Ward (6+).

armySpecialRules.name: HARMONY
armySpecialRules.description:
Most of Grand Cathay's units are divided into two categories, Yin and/or Yang as described in the army list. Unless specified, models armed with missile weapons counts as Yin, and models armed with only close combat weapons counts as Yang.
When a Yin unit is within 3" of non-fleeing Yang units with a combined Unit Strength 5 or more, they may re- roll 1's To Hit with missile weapons. When a Yang unit is within 3" of non-fleeing Yin units with a combined Unit Strength 5 or more, the Yang unit may re-roll 1's To Wound in close combat.

armySpecialRules.name: MASTERY OF THE ELEMENTAL WINDS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule gain a +1 casting bonus if there is one or more friendly non-fleeing models with this special rule within 12".

armySpecialRules.name: WILL OF THE DRAGONS
armySpecialRules.description: A unit with this special rule may re-roll failed Panic tests caused by friendly units breaking from combat or getting destroyed within 6" of them, or when it is fled through by a friendly unit.

armySpecialRules.name: CELESTIAL BLADE
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | As user | Parry (6+)
A Celestial Blade gives the wielder +1 To Wound.

armySpecialRules.name: CRANE GUN
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
18/36" | 6 | Move or Fire*, Ponderous,
*Does not apply if mounted on a Chariot.

armySpecialRules.name: DRAGON FIRE PISTOLS
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
8/12" | 5 | Armour Piercing (1), Flaming Attacks, Quick Shot

armySpecialRules.name: DRAGON FIRE BOMBS
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
6/9" | 5 | Armour Piercing (1), Flaming Attacks (non- physical), March & Shoot, Quick Shot
Each Hit from a dragon fire bomb is multiplied into D3 Hits.

armySpecialRules.name: REPEATER CROSSBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
12/18" | 2 | Multiple Shots (3), Rapid Fire

armySpecialRules.name: THREE-EYED GUN
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
9/18" | 5 | Multiple Shots (3), Ponderous, Rapid Fire

magicItems.name: JADE BLADE OF THE GREAT FLEET
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 Strength and the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: NUKU CHO'S CROSSBOW
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
18/24" | 3 | Multiple Shots (6), Rapid Fire

magicItems.name: SILVER MOON BOW
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 4 | Armour Piercing (3), Multiple Shots (3)

magicItems.name: SPIRIT LONGMA SPEAR
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Ignores Armour saves special rule.

magicItems.name: VORPAL SHARD
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon always Wounds on a 2+.

magicItems.name: THE BRAZEN BLADE
magicItems.description: This weapon has the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule. In addition, Ward saves (except Dodge and Parry) cannot be taken against Wounds caused by it.

magicItems.name: DAWN GLAIVE
magicItems.description: All enemy attacks against the wielder of this weapon suffer -1 To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: THE SWORD OF REASON
magicItems.description: This weapon has the Killing Blow special rules, which takes effect on a 5+ rather than a 6.

magicItems.name: ASCENDANT CELESTIAL BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 Strength.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF XEN WU
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 Strength and +1 Attack. However, any unit joined by them cannot use their Leadership.

magicItems.name: SERPENT FANG
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Armour Piercing (2) and Poisoned Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF NAN-GAU
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Armour Piercing (3) and Hatred (Chaos) special rules.

magicItems.name: VERMILLION BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 To Hit and the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: SUN & MOON BLADES
magicItems.description: These weapons have the Armour Piercing (1) and Immunity (Killing Blow) special rules.

magicItems.name: WRATH OF XEN YANG
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: JADE ARMOUR OF BEICHAI
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains a Magical Ward (5+) and the Magic Resistance (2) special rule.

magicItems.name: QUICKSILVER ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: SCALES OF THE CELESTIAL COURT
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Natural Armour (5+) and Strider special rules.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE WARBIRD
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Fly (10) and Independent special rules.

magicItems.name: ASCENDANT CELESTIAL ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour is immune to penalties to any of their characteristics and automatically passes all characteristics tests.

magicItems.name: LAMINATE SHIELD
magicItems.description: Every time the bearer of this shield makes a successful Parry save, they may immediately make an additional Attack back against the model that struck the blow.

magicItems.name: MANTLE OF HEAVEN
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains a 5+ armour save against non-magical missile attacks.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF NAN-GAU
magicItems.description: The bearer gains +2 armour save against all attacks to their front in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: GUARDIAN FENG SHI BO
magicItems.description: All close combat and missile attacks targeting the bearer of this item must re-roll successful To Hit rolls.

magicItems.name: ROBES OF SHANG YANG
magicItems.description: This item contains the Wall of Wind & Fire spell from the Lore of Yang. In addition, the bearer gains a Magical Ward (6+) against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: CRYSTAL OF KUNLAN
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a Magical Ward (5+). In addition, for each successful Ward save they make in close combat, the enemy that struck the blow immediately suffers a Strength 3 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: JET AMULET
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item and any unit they join gain the Magic Resistance (2) special rule. In addition, they may re-roll any failed dispel attempts against spells directly targeting them or their unit.

magicItems.name: SIGIL OF SMOKE & POWDER
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeting the bearer of this item or any unit they are with suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: JADE BLOOD PENDANT
magicItems.description: Whenever the bearer kills one or more enemy models in close combat, roll a D6 at the end of the Close Combat phase. On the roll of a 5+, the bearer recovers a single Wound lost earlier in the battle.

magicItems.name: JAR OF ALL SOULS
magicItems.description: If the bearer of this item is killed, immediately roll a D6. On a 2+, they come back to life with 1 Wound remaining.

magicItems.name: CELESTIAL SILK ROBE
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item gains the Magical Ward (6+) and Magic Resistance (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF JADE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a 4+ invulnerable save against all enemy spells.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF PO MEI
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting and dispelling bonus.

magicItems.name: CLOCKWORK COMPASS
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. Once used, all Remains in Play spells within 24" of the bearer that are currently in play are automatically dispelled, and the effects of all other spells within 24" of the bearer immediately come to an end.

magicItems.name: JADE AMULET
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll failed channelling attempts.

magicItems.name: SCROLLS OF ASTROMANCY
magicItems.description: Astromancer only. The bearer can re-roll all of the dice rolled to cast or dispel a spell once per Magic phase. This can effectively cancel a miscast result, and cause Ultimate Power or a miscast.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF WU XING
magicItems.description: The bearer of this staff can choose to re-roll all the Winds of Magic dice each Magic phase.

magicItems.name: SCROLLS OF WEI-JIN
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Loremaster special rule. However, they may only attempt to cast a number of spells equal to their Wizard Level.

magicItems.name: MAW SHARD
magicItems.description: The Maw Shard may be used in any of your Magic phases. Once used, any double (except double 1's) rolled when the bearer casts spells counts towards Ultimate Power this turn.

magicItems.name: SEAL OF XING PO
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may choose spells from both the Lore of Yin and Yang in addition to the spells from their other lore.

magicItems.name: ALCHEMIST'S MASK
magicItems.description: This item contains the Transmutation of Lead spell from the Lore of Metal.

magicItems.name: ICON OF THE SPIRIT DRAGON
magicItems.description: This item contains the Ancestral Warriors spell from the Lore of Yin.

magicItems.name: KITE OF THE UTTERMOST AIRS
magicItems.description: The bearer can use this item in the Shooting phase. Choose one enemy unit with the Fly special rule within 12" that is not in close combat; they suffer D6 Strength 4 automatic Hits.

magicItems.name: CLEANSING WATER
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item and unit they join gains the Mighty Blow (1) special rule in turns that they charge.

magicItems.name: CRACKLEBLAZE
magicItems.description: This item can be used in the Shooting phase. Place the small 3" template with the hole anywhere within 6". It scatters D3". Any model under the template suffer a Strength 4 hits with the Flaming Attacks and Ignores Armour saves special rule.

magicItems.name: SPIRIT LANTERN
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Terror special rule. In addition, they may re-roll To Wound rolls of 1 against Daemons, Undead and Vampires.

magicItems.name: CATALYTIC KILN
magicItems.description: All enemy models in base contact with the bearer of this item suffer a Strength 3 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule at the start of each close combat phase. Models with Immunity (Flaming Attacks) suffer a Strength 2 Hit.

magicItems.name: ASTROMANCER'S SPYGLASS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gives you +1 to choose which side of the table to deploy on, choosing the first turn and rolling for Ambushers to arrive. In addition, all enemy units within 30" must reveal all Hidden models and magic items they might have.

magicItems.name: FAN OF THE MAGISTER
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item allows friendly units to re-roll failed Leadership tests when attempting to use the Tactician special rule. In addition, enemy units within 12" must re-roll successful tests to march, counter-charge, redirect charges, restrain from pursuit and reform.

magicItems.name: FIRES OF NAN-GAU
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a Breath Weapon with Strength 4 and the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: GOLDEN LION
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item and any unit they are with may re-roll failed Psychology tests.

magicItems.name: VERMILLION QUILLS
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of close combat. The bearer of this item can re-roll all failed To Hit and To Wound rolls this turn.

magicItems.name: ALCHEMIST'S ELIXIR OF IRON SKIN
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any phase. The character gains the Natural Armour save (3+) special rule until the end of the turn.

magicItems.name: ALCHEMIST'S ELIXIR OF PUISSANCE
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any phase. The character gains +1 Strength and Attacks until the end of the turn.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF THE MOON WIND
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Scouts special rule.

magicItems.name: ALCHEMIST'S ELIXIR OF VENOM
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any phase. The character gains the Poisoned Attacks special rule until the end of the turn.

magicItems.name: FLAG OF GRAND CATHAY
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Hold Your Ground (6) special rule. In addition, friendly units within 18" count as being in Harmony if within 6" of eligible Yin/Yang units rather than 3".

magicItems.name: THE GREAT CELESTIAL BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains the Magical Ward (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: JADE BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains +2 combat resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF WEI JIN
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains +1 to their Leadership, and enemy units in base contact suffer -1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF FENG SHI
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains the Immunity (Psychology) and Magical Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE EMPRESS' EYE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains +1 to Hit with missile weapons.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE MOON EMPRESS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains the Scouts special rule.

magicItems.name: REVERED BANNER OF THE ANCESTORS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains +1 Weapon Skill.

magicItems.name: SERENE CLOUD PRAYER FLAG
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains the Cold-blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF HEAVENLY FURY
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any enemy Movement phase. Until the start of your next turn, no enemy unit within 24" of this banner can use the Fly special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE DRAGON'S WRATH
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains the Flaming Attacks and Impact Hits (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF SHANG-YANG
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner may re-roll 1's when taking armour saves.

magicItems.name: DRAGON'S EYE BANNER
magicItems.description: Whenever the unit carrying this standard is the target of an enemy spell, roll a D6. On a 3+, the enemy Wizard must choose another target. If no other target is available, the spell cannot be cast.

magicItems.name: BASTION STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner only suffer half (rounding up) their normal Leadership penalty when taking Break tests and may re-roll failed Break tests.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF NAN-GAU
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner gains 6" to the effective range of their missile weapons.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF XEN WUN
magicItems.description: Enemy units cannot choose to Stand & Shoot against the unit carrying this banner.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF YIN
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a spell from the Lore of Yin is successfully cast, all enemy units within 6" of the caster suffer -1 to their armour saves until the start of the caster's next magic phase.

spells.name: STORM OF SHADOWS
spells.description: Storm of Shadows is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit suffer -1 to their Movement and have their Line of Sight limited to 12" until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: CLOAK OF JET
spells.description: Cloak of Jet is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, no enemy spells can target the unit.

spells.name: MISSILE MIRROR
spells.description: Missile Mirror is a hex spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, roll a D6 for every shot the target unit fires in the Shooting phase. On a 4+, that shot is instead resolved against the target unit. Attacks that use templates are not affected.

spells.name: BLOSSOM WIND
spells.description: Blossom Wind is a direct damage spell with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 2 Hits with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. In addition, the target unit suffer -1 to its Weapon Skill and Ballistics skill until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: TALONS OF NIGHT
spells.description: Remains in play. Talons of Night is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template suffer a Strength 4 Hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

spells.name: ANCESTRAL WARRIORS
spells.description: Ancestral Warriors is a direct damage spell with a range of 18". The target unit suffers 5D6 Attacks with Weapon Skill 4 and Strength Hits 4, resolved as close combat attacks.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF YANG
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a spell from the Lore of Yang is successfully cast, all friendly units within 6" of the caster gain the Armour Piercing (1) special rule until the start of the caster's next magic phase.

spells.name: JADE SHIELD
spells.description: Jade Shield is an augment spell with a range of 12". The target unit gains a Magical Ward (6+) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: STONE GROUND STANCE
spells.description: Stone Ground Stance is an augment spell with a range of 24". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, the target unit gains the Stubborn special rule (if they are already Stubborn, they instead become Unbreakable) and enemies charging them lose all charge bonuses.

spells.name: DRAGON'S BREATH
spells.description: Dragon's Breath is a direct damage spell. The caster makes a Breath Weapon Attack. This may be cast in close combat, following the normal rules for Breath Weapons. All models Hit suffer a Strength 5 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

spells.name: WALL OF WIND & FIRE
spells.description: Wall of Wind & Fire is a direct damage spell with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 3 Hits with the Flaming Attacks special rule. In addition, the target unit suffer -1 to Leadership until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: MIGHT OF HEAVEN & EARTH
spells.description: Might of Heaven & Earth is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit gains +1 Weapon Skill, +1 Strength, Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: CONSTELLATION OF THE DRAGON
spells.description: Constellation of the Dragon is a direct damage area spell with a range of 24" that uses the small round template. All models underneath the template suffer a Strength 5 Hit with the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.
